title: Transaction Fee Terms for Sales on the Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
**Clause 1 — the rate a sale is priced at.** Every sale on a Pocketwire Business Profile books a transaction fee on the sale date at the rate of its sale channel: the in-app and online-checkout rate for in-app and online-checkout sales, the QR-code rate for in-person QR-code sales, the tap-to-pay rate for tap-to-pay sales and the invoice rate for sales paid through a Pocketwire invoice. A sale below the micropayment threshold uses the micropayment rate whatever its channel; the micropayment rate and a channel rate never apply together.

**Clause 2 — the amount.** The transaction fee is the sale amount multiplied by the rate's percentage, rounded to the cent (half up), plus the rate's fixed part.

**Clause 3 — cross-border sales.** A sale from an international buyer also books a cross-border fee of the sale amount multiplied by the cross-border percentage, rounded to the cent (half up). The cross-border fee has no fixed part and is booked in addition to the transaction fee.

**Clause 4 — which tier's rates.** The tier whose rates apply is the tier the profile held on the sale date; a later tier change never re-prices earlier sales.

The rates themselves are those of the seller rate card for each tier.

## Worked figures (hypothetical rates, not rate-card figures)

| Sale | Rate used | Transaction fee | Cross-border fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 123.45 in-app, domestic buyer, channel rate 2.00% plus USD 0.30 | channel | 123.45 multiplied by 2.00% is 2.469, rounded to 2.47, plus 0.30: USD 2.77 | none |
| USD 123.45 in-app, international buyer, same channel rate, cross-border 1.00% | channel | USD 2.77 | 1.2345 rounded to USD 1.23 |
| USD 8.00 by QR code, threshold USD 10.00, micropayment rate 5.00% plus USD 0.10 | micropayment | 0.40 plus 0.10: USD 0.50 | none |

A sale of exactly the threshold amount is not below it and is priced at its channel rate.
